g.title: KayaRank2Convo1 begins.
g.text: KayaRank2Convo1 begins.

g.title: j2263752133
g.text: Hey Kaya!

g.title: j3829678237
g.text: Nova, I go by Nova online.

g.title: j4224155818
g.text: Okay, Nova then.

g.title: j2739032532
g.text: I see. Since when?

g.title: j3703157791
g.text: K thanks, just don't call me Kaya on the internet. You can call me that in person, but here: NOVA. Ok?

g.title: j3151524087
g.text: Um does it matter? It's the internet, I'd rather not use my real name.

g.title: j466945844
g.text: Okay, but can I ask why?

g.title: j3246526554
g.text: Got it. Nova. Nova. Right. I wanted to ask: Is there anything I can do to make things more comfortable for you here?

g.title: j578044180
g.text: Right yah, wouldn't want people seeing how often you ask me about time travel.

g.title: j1270361079
g.text: Oh? I'm pretty sure Amir has this network pretty locked down, unless I'm missing something?

g.title: j3904602681
g.text: Did you ask anyone else if they had a nickname they liked? Just get with it.

g.title: j2857489788
g.text: I know none of us really asked to 'be here' in this makeshift home but we're doing our best.

g.title: j2052285451
g.text: Are you for real? The internet is dangerous. Like, actually.

g.title: j1517344650
g.text: It matters to me. I don't want anyone to ever find Kaya online again.

g.title: j1036347057
g.text: Hmm. Umm. Hmm. Comfortable. No one has spread any rumors about me have they?

g.title: j2107718988
g.text: Did something happen to you?

g.title: j2511376898
g.text: And you think time travel isn't?

g.title: j1356771172
g.text: The time cops won't get you I swear.

g.title: j3987989002
g.text: Get yourself into some trouble?

g.title: j2377522714
g.text: Well Aoi did say...

g.title: j3642963891
g.text: Not a word. Only happy you're here.

g.title: j960515419
g.text: Check boolean KayaSetKid

g.title: j4294415938
g.text: Check boolean KayaSetKid

g.title: j3298161901
g.text: Ugh. Not funny.

g.title: j2173315211
g.text: I made a DUMB Mistake. Once.

g.title: j505536242
g.text: Don't even joke actually.

g.title: j3406141100
g.text: Arthur and Eleanor definitely see you as a little sister who is way smarter than them.

g.title: j2385617024
g.text: You're the one that says I'm like a kid, what if something did happen to me?

g.title: j960515419->j2385617024
g.text: true

g.title: j1753738107
g.text: Nothing that I can change now.

g.title: j960515419->j1753738107
g.text: false

g.title: j1671781286
g.text: Listen I know you think I'm just a kid.

g.title: j4294415938->j1671781286
g.text: true

g.title: j4091305516
g.text: Fine. You're right.

g.title: j4294415938->j4091305516
g.text: false

g.title: j2292283515
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3645297935
g.text: And I don't make mistakes.

g.title: j624506980
g.text: It's not even funny. You put girls like us in a room and everyone expect us to be at each other's throats.

g.title: j710978250
g.text: Amir and Quincy cannot get over your Wormhole and I swear when you aren't looking they jump through it.

g.title: j500475234
g.text: Then I would hope you can see from the people around you that we're a team that helps each other.

g.title: j2988068299
g.text: Well, is that why you want to figure out this time travel thing? To prove something?

g.title: j1427231920
g.text: But

g.title: j3005877787
g.text: It probably is. And because of that, I have to know how to do it right. Can't make mistakes.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo2.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo2.

g.title: j2292283515->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo2.
j3086939292
g.text: So give me just a few more days, maybe a few weeks, and I'll have this whole thing figured out and it's goodbye 1999.

g.title: j2298992991
g.text: Jealousy. Comparisons. Ugh. I'm done with that part of my life. Do not try and turn me against the other girls.

g.title: j1244987413
g.text: Aoi and Lettie can't seem to decide if they want to be your best friend or your mother.

g.title: j1835122856
g.text: Mmm.

g.title: j2711042857
g.text: Maybe.

g.title: j2892505843
g.text: Bet on it.

g.title: j1209691337
g.text: And of course me, I'm happy someone wants to understand how the hell I ended up here.

g.title: j787700223
g.text: You are right. You aren't exactly unpopular.

g.title: j3898456205
g.text: Why do you care, actually?

g.title: j915401444
g.text: You guys actually... like me?

g.title: j3272885779
g.text: And everyone does seem to trust you, or at least say they do.

g.title: j1173333211
g.text: Trusting people and working together is what makes us us.

g.title: j3603946852
g.text: Caring about my friends is a strength. It's a reason to endure all this shit.

g.title: j2673243050
g.text: We all have our shit to deal with. It's hard to do alone.

g.title: j165978842
g.text: We're just waiting for you to feel comfortable around us.

g.title: j414014320
g.text: How could we not?

g.title: j394766465
g.text: LOL Sounds like something from a sorority slogan.

g.title: j2546257714
g.text: I... see.

g.title: j3289129035
g.text: What exactly is a 'sorority slogan'?

g.title: j2787354989
g.text: Sorority? What's that.

g.title: j768061301
g.text: LOL Really? I really have to go to the future if there's none of those there. Holy shit.

g.title: j1865727437
g.text: Not following...

g.title: j2437525607
g.text: In University a bunch of girls call themselves sisters and think it means something. Like a 'club' I guess.

g.title: j2377998950
g.text: Oh, maybe like 'The Sisters of Parvos'?

g.title: j1509924743
g.text: Sounds lame. Ugh. I freaking HOPE it's not a real sorority.

g.title: j1655043238
g.text: Well, they try to kill me. A lot.

g.title: j2617793550
g.text: Feels like mine tried to kill me too...
